title: Move to the lore/quest 0.12.0 pair: regenerate the managed Quest block and bump the lore CI pin
description: Orchestrator dispatch OPAG-967. npm latest for @opum-ai/quest and @opum-ai/lore is 0.12.0, and the workstation global installs moved to 0.12.0 at 23:40Z; sdlc-audit reading origin/dev still finds the pair pinned at 0.11.0 in two live places: the CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.11.0, and .github/workflows/ci.yml line 70 sets LORE_VERSION=0.11.0. The CI tracker job derives QUEST_VERSION from the managed block, so there is no separate quest pin in CI. Regenerating the block is the routine managed-block carve-out, generated bytes only. Deliberately out of scope: the 23 docs frontmatter by: lore/0.11.0 provenance stamps, which record which lore version wrote each document and are history rather than live pins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The CLAUDE.md managed Quest block declares Quest CLI 0.12.0, the regeneration changed bytes only inside the managed markers, and quest agents --check --require-installed --target claude exits 0
ci.yml LORE_VERSION reads 0.12.0 and no live CI pin of @opum-ai/lore, @opum-ai/quest or LORE_VERSION still reads 0.11.0
The PR head SHA is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity, with the Docs job installing lore 0.12.0 and the Tracker job installing the quest version the regenerated block declares

plan: Regenerate the managed Quest block: quest agents --update-instructions --target claude; assert every changed byte is inside the managed markers
Local gates at 0.12.0: quest agents --check, lore agents --check, lore validate --strict, lore check --strict, scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs, bun run check
Commit, push, open the PR into dev; wait on the head SHA check-runs (newest per context)
Complete WCLI-67 on the branch, citing the PR and the run that validated it; wait for the merge-gate run on the closure commit
Squash merge, delete the local branch
Promote dev to main at orchestrator direction; read origin/main back by ref; report to opum-agent
finalSummary: Move to the lore/quest 0.12.0 pair lands in opum-ai/ward-cli#142 (squash into dev). The managed Quest block was regenerated 0.11.0 -> 0.12.0 by quest agents --update-instructions --target claude under the routine managed-block carve-out: a one-line generated change inside the markers, asserted with the opum-workflow outsideMarkers helper (outside-markers residue byte-identical, declared version 0.12.0). The ci.yml LORE_VERSION pin moved 0.11.0 -> 0.12.0. The CI Tracker job derives quest from the regenerated block, so the block is the only quest pin. Local gates on the workstation at lore 0.12.0 / quest 0.12.0: quest agents --check exit 0; lore agents --check exit 0; lore validate --strict 0 errors and 0 warnings over 27 files; lore check --strict 0 errors with agent profiles 4 read, 0 over capacity (the new 0.12.0 agent-profile-capacity finding, LCLI-642, is clean here, so no max_tokens change was needed); scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs 23 concepts, 0 in no profile; bun run check exit 0 (705 pass / 0 fail); git diff --check clean. The PR head run 36792667828 is green in Check, Docs and Tracker integrity on commit 17044513998bf5a46bd6ce1bb2f94d1a0729334f: the Tracker job resolved and installed Quest 0.12.0 from the regenerated block (log line: Declared Quest version: 0.12.0) and the Docs job installed lore 0.12.0 under its equality guard. The 23 docs frontmatter provenance stamps (by: lore/0.11.0) are history and were deliberately left alone. This completion is committed on the branch; the merge gate is the run on the closure commit.
